title: Stack Up
tagline: Drop, line up, and build high.
description: A block slides across the screen. Tap to drop it on the tower, and any overhang is sliced off. Land blocks perfectly to build a combo.
bestFor: timing, focus, and quick one-thumb sessions.
controls: tap/click or press Space or Enter to drop.
glance: tap, or press Space or Enter, to drop a block.
short: Tap to drop sliding blocks and build the tallest tower. Land blocks perfectly to build a combo.
about: A one-tap timing game. A block slides across the screen, and you drop it onto a growing tower. Overhanging parts are sliced off, and perfect drops build a combo. The sky changes from day to night as your tower climbs.
